method.scoring: RAF intervals, whole operation wall boundaries unchanged. No mid-sample AX, screenshots, CPU profiling, builds or tests. New-process excludes application startup; hot means canvas unmount/remount, not Vite HMR. Each drag contains six effective gestures / 90 DOM mouse steps and complete recovery; not OS pointer input.
method.diagnostics: Separate profiling React bundle; supported onRender/onCommit/onPostCommit callbacks observed, explicit application measurement spans, RAF/ResizeObserver callbacks and installed React Flow store actions. Native 15s Time Profiler traces attached only to isolated WebContent. Frontend epoch/performance anchor correlates frame windows with CPU samples.
method.accounting: Span totals are inclusive/nested. Clip and union synchronous spans before subtraction. React duration belongs to callback endpoint; it is not an exact exclusive frame interval. commit-wall is coarse wall time from React commitTime to profiler onRender, not just layout effects. Unknown wall time remains unknown; no frame-minus-JS equals paint or GPU claim. CPU categories are mutually exclusive stack heuristics with statistical sample weight, not exact paint elapsed durations.
method.overhead: Diagnostic results are not scored. Default app and final benchmark do not install observers, alias profiling React, or transform React Flow; no production clock reads/trace retention when application observer is absent. Diagnostic recording is bounded and reports dropped events.
method.limits: Small local samples; no stable FPS, statistically significant benefit, universal improvement or new memory/leak claim. Long Tasks unsupported/null is not zero long tasks.
